summary: The framework has one class, SFAuthorization, which asks the system to authorize and preauthorize named rights for privileged operations. BifrOSt enforces per-app manifest permissions in the shell and has no SDK call for an app to check or request an authorization right; the nearest app-facing feature is the permission-gated keychain.

features.feature: SFAuthorization object and rights (obtain(withRights:flags:environment:authorizedRights:), obtain(withRight:flags:), authorizationRef())
features.apple: SFAuthorization, authorization(), init(flags:rights:environment:), obtain(withRights:...), obtain(withRight:flags:), authorizationRef()
features.bifrost: none in springboard/sdk/src/ (no authorization API; grep for authoriz and entitlement returns nothing in the SDK)
features.note: an app cannot ask the shell to authorize or preauthorize a named right for a privileged operation

features.feature: Per-app permission enforcement (restrict features by manifest permission)
features.apple: SFAuthorization restricts a user's access to features in an app or daemon
features.bifrost: springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs (Policy::from_permissions: network, storage, audio, notifications, documents, keychain; with_entitlements for first-party log-store)
features.note: the shell enforces grants from the package manifest at launch; the app cannot query or request them at run time, and there is no user prompt for a grant
no concept of cached authorization credentials to drop
no rights or environment parameters exist in any SDK call

features.feature: Secret storage gated by an app permission
features.apple: Closest related Apple surface is Keychain Services; SFAuthorization is not a keychain API
features.note: gated by the manifest keychain permission only; no user authentication step and no per-right authorization

gaps: No SDK call for an app to request or check an authorization right (obtain / obtain withRight) before a privileged operation.
No user-facing authorization prompt that grants a right at run time; the manifest permission is the only grant.
No invalidateCredentials equivalent for dropping preserved authorization.
No rights, flags or environment model in the app API.
